children.text: This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for Nex, Angel of Death, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found here
⬥ This achievement requires the player to defeat Nex, Angel of Death in a team of 5 or fewer without anyone dying while completing the following.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Freedom and don't run into anyone. Free teammates from ice
. Also requires player to Freedom during Zaros Phase under effects of Glacies Pillar.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Place smokes parallel to walls (East smoke south wall, north smoke west wall etc.) so the smoke doesn't spawn.

Base runs AoD west at 600k, down to Fumus pillar. The team will lower Umbra pillar down to 30k health and run up to Glacies pillar. The base will pull AoD to Umbra and wait for the team to be ready. Third bomb is usually a good time as it will enable base to re-overload and prep 5 stack volley. The base will
call. Base can then use any ability to kill the pillar once they have seen the bomb runner barge the dummy and in position under Glacies Pillar.
